sources.description:
Henry Hsu Portrait

Henry Hsu, known in Mandarin as 許富凱, is captured here in a close-up portrait wearing a gray plaid blazer over a white shirt, accessorized with gold earrings and a delicate necklace. His warm gaze and styled brown hair reflect his polished public image as a successful singer.

Since debuting on August 25, 2011 with his first album "最愛," Hsu has released eight personal albums, with his debut reaching number two on the Rose Records sales chart. He has been nominated six times for the Golden Melody Award for Best Taiwanese Male Singer and has recently expanded into acting roles in Taiwanese film and television.

sources.title: Fu Kai Hsu / 許富凱 – NEONMUSIC
sources.description:
Fu Kai Hsu Artist Portrait

Fu Kai Hsu, also known by his Chinese name 許富凱, is presented in a formal studio portrait on NEONMUSIC’s website. He wears a sleek black suit paired with a white tie detail that drapes over his shoulders, set against a simple gray background. His neatly styled hair and composed expression convey a professional and polished image.

This portrait serves as the visual centerpiece of Fu Kai Hsu’s collection page on NEONMUSIC. Although the page is designed to showcase his work, it currently lists no products, indicating it functions primarily as an artist profile rather than a merchandise catalog.

許富凱正式肖像照

許富凱身着灰色西裝，搭配淺藍襯衫與紅色領帶，面向鏡頭整理領帶，神情專注而沉穩。淺色純色背景突顯了他的服裝細節與專業形象，畫面簡潔而有力。

許富凱 Spotify Artist Portrait

許富凱 appears in a studio portrait set against a warm, textured orange backdrop. He wears a black coat layered over a white shirt, and his dark hair is styled to frame his face. His direct gaze and neutral expression convey a composed and professional presence.

This image serves as the artist profile picture on 許富凱’s Spotify page, which notes that he has 235.2K monthly listeners. The portrait’s contrasting colors and simple composition highlight the singer’s features and create a memorable visual identity for his music platform.

sources.description:
許富凱紅色外套宣傳照

金曲歌王許富凱身著鮮紅色針織外套，雙手自然插入口袋，面對鏡頭展現沉穩而親切的神情。淺色背景襯托出外套的鮮豔色彩，整體畫面簡潔明亮。

這張形象照與他即將於8月8日父親節當天在台北小巨蛋舉辦的《許富凱一五一拾台北小巨蛋演唱會》宣傳活動相呼應。演唱會名稱「一五一拾」象徵他出道十五年與「拾歌」系列的延續，並將帶來過去精選作品、經典台語歌曲翻唱及新專輯曲目三種不同感官體驗。
